name: blogizi
description: Draft, update, and publish SEO blog posts to your Blogizi blog from Gemini CLI. Bundles the Blogizi skill and the hosted Blogizi MCP server.

blogizi.description: Official Blogizi MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). Authorizes via OAuth on first connection: Gemini CLI opens a browser to sign in to Blogizi; no token or local install required.
